title: EP 32 — --ADD-DIR
sub: Give Claude a second working directory at launch
lines: Clawd only sees the directory you launched it in. But real work spans repos.
Pass dash dash add dash dir at startup. Now Clawd can read and edit that sibling directory too.
Files in the added directory follow the same rules as your main one. Readable without prompts.
Clawd checks every path exists before it starts. Bad path, it tells you up front.
It grants file access, not a config root. It's reach, not setup.
Want it every session? Add the paths to permissions dot additional Directories. Follow for a daily Clawd tip.
